honest_verdict: R1 and R2 (IK quality on REACHABLE targets) are high; R3 (arbitrary 6D poses) is lower, but the gap is largely GENUINE UNREACHABILITY - most random orientations at a random position lie outside a 6-DOF arm's workspace - rather than IK weakness. A plannability rate measured on reachable targets is therefore the right capability number, and calling the arbitrary-pose rate an IK failure rate conflates IK quality with reachability.
